verses.translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the highest.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi pe Domnul din ceruri, lăudaţi-L pe El întru cele înalte.
translations.grk: Ἀλληλούϊα· Ἀγγαίου καὶ Ζαχαρίου. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.

verses.translation: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi-L pe El toţi îngerii Lui, lăudaţi-L pe El toate puterile Lui.
translations.grk: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Praise him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars and light.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi-L pe El soarele şi luna, lăudaţi-L pe El toate stelele şi lumina.
translations.grk: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν ἥλιος καὶ σελήνη, αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν πάντα τὰ ἄστρα καὶ τὸ φῶς.

verses.translation: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and the water that is above the heavens.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi-L pe El cerurile cerurilor şi apa cea mai presus de ceruri,
translations.grk: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν.

verses.translation: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he spoke, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created.

translations.ron: Să laude numele Domnului, că El a zis şi s-au făcut, El a poruncit şi s-au zidit.
translations.grk: Αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου· ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν καὶ ἐγενήθησαν, αὐτὸς ἐνετείλατο καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.

verses.translation: He has established them for ever, even for ever and ever: he has made an ordinance, and it shall not pass away.

translations.ron: Pusu-le-ai pe ele în veac şi în veacul veacului; lege le-a pus şi nu o vor trece.
translations.grk: Ἔστησεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· πρόσταγμα ἔθετο, καὶ οὐ παρελεύσεται.

verses.translation: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye serpents, and all deeps.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi pe Domnul toţi cei de pe pământ, balaurii şi toate adâncurile;
translations.grk: Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῆς γῆς, δράκοντες καὶ πᾶσαι ἄβυσσοι·

verses.translation: Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy wind; the things that perform his word.

translations.ron: Focul, grindina, zăpada, gheaţa, viforul, toate îndepliniţi cuvântul Lui;
translations.grk: Πῦρ, χάλαζα, χιὼν, κρύσταλλος, πνεῦμα καταιγίδος, τὰ ποιοῦντα τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ·

verses.translation: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

translations.ron: Munţii şi toate dealurile, pomii cei roditori şi toţi cedrii;
translations.grk: Τὰ ὄρη καὶ πάντες βουνοί, ξύλα καρποφόρα καὶ πᾶσαι κέδροι·

verses.translation: wild beasts, and all cattle; reptiles, and winged birds:

translations.ron: Fiarele şi toate animalele, târâtoarele şi păsările cele zburătoare;
translations.grk: Τὰ θηρία καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη, ἑρπετὰ καὶ πετεινὰ πτερωτά·

verses.translation: kings of the earth, and all peoples; princes, and all judges of the earth:

translations.ron: Împăraţii pământului şi toate popoarele, căpeteniile şi toţi judecătorii pământului;
translations.grk: Βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντες λαοί, ἄρχοντες καὶ πάντες κριταὶ γῆς·

verses.translation: young men and virgins, old men with youths:

translations.ron: Tinerii şi fecioarele, bătrânii cu tinerii,
translations.grk: Νεανίσκοι καὶ παρθένοι, πρεσβύται μετὰ νεωτέρων

verses.translation: let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name only is exalted; his praise is above the earth and heaven,

translations.ron: Să laude numele Domnului, că numai numele Lui s-a înălţat. Lauda Lui pe pământ şi în cer.
translations.grk: αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, ὅτι ὑψώθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ μόνου· ἡ ἐξομολόγησις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ γῆς καὶ οὐρανοῦ,

verses.translation: and he shall exalt the horn of his people, there is a hymn for all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people who draw near to him.

translations.ron: Şi va înălţa puterea poporului Lui. Cântare tuturor cuvioşilor Lui, fiilor lui Israel, poporului ce se apropie de El.
translations.grk: καὶ ὑψώσει κέρας λαοῦ αὐτοῦ· ὕμονς πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ, τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ, λαῷ ἐγγίζοντι αὐτῷ.
